extra_quotes: The chiral metasurface was fabricated using electron -beam lithography followed by inductively coupled plasma reactive-ion etching (see Methods for details).

For third -harmonic generation (THG) measurements, the incoherent light source was replaced with a home-built wavelength-tunable optical parametric amplifier (OPA) used in Ref. 70 pumped by a pulsed laser (Amplitude Yuja, center wavelength of 1030 nm, repetition rate of 100 kHz, and pulse duration of 400 fs).

The experimentally observed deviation of 𝑆3(3𝜔) from unity can be attributed to fabrication -induced symmetry breaking, as well as to deviations of the excitation beam from an ideal circularly polarized plane wave.
